title: Reference approach: Random Data Explorer
approach: Validate external input shape, dtype, and fields before numerical work.
Use ndarray operations and choose explicit axes and tolerance rules.
Separate loading, transformation, analysis, and reporting into testable functions.
Use synthetic fixtures and test invalid/boundary cases.
Record assumptions, environment versions, and performance measurements.
acceptance_guidance: Sample from at least two distributions.
Save and reload the sample using a numeric file format.
explanation: Generate reproducible synthetic datasets and explore their statistical properties. This is a reference approach, not a complete executable deliverable. Final reference code and tests require technical review before release.
